subject: REWRITE statement
notes: "After the execution of the REWRITE statement is complete, the information in the area referenced by identifier-1 is available, provided that identifier-1 is not one or part of one of the record descriptions subordinate to the file-description ..." The emitters only READ identifier-1 (the bound implicit MOVE, GR7 a)) and never store into it; the runtime receives a string image. Probe pa.cob: after `REWRITE R2 FROM W20` W20 still displays YYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYY. The subordinate case is 'not available' = unspecified content, which any behaviour satisfies. cite.py --check 14.9.35.4 GR10 -> OK. No spec-derived test pins it. [editions as adjudicated: 2023 (clarified in 2023 per Annex E.3.3 item 41: identifier-1 subordinate to the FD is not available); the availability of a non-subordinate identifier-1 is unchanged in 2014]
